QuestInfo.name: [10th Anniversary] Scholarly 'Shroom's Calling
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #b#p9000292##k, who is looking for you.
QuestInfo.2: You heard secrets from #b#p9000292##k about the monsters.

0.0: Greetings, human! They call me #p9000292#. I've heard a LOT about you and your work. They said you've got quite a good head on your shoulders.
0.1: I'll cut to the chase. Maple World is already 10 years old, and yet there's still so much we don't know about it. Like monsters, for example. Where do they come from, really?
0.2: I promise, this will be fun. You get to learn the secrets of monsters, and earn some rewards, too! You can get the #i2432710# #r#t2432710##k... Or the #i1142726# #r#t1142726##k title! Come find out what secrets I'm talking about!

yes.0: I'll be waiting for you at the #b#m910196000##k. You can use the #b#t2432708##k to teleport!

no.0: I thought you humans cared about bettering yourselves...
